name: us-build-a-colony
description: Build-a-Colony — Unit 1 U.S. History strategy game (TEKS 8.2B, 8.10B, 8.11A, 8.12A, 8.31B). Draw a region — New England, Middle, or Southern — and steer a 1620 colony through ten years and twelve decisions where the right answer depends entirely on your geography. Server-authoritative Socket.IO backend with a live Teacher Command Center.
comment: No npm workspaces: this drive is exFAT, which cannot host the symlinks/junctions workspace linking requires. server/ and client/ install independently; `npm install` here cascades via postinstall.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --no-fund --no-audit && npm install --prefix client --no-fund --no-audit
